m.t: Ona nám zrovna zničila naši nejlepší šanci na záchranu světa.
m.e: This chick just ruined our best shot at saving the world.

m.t: Přišli jsme vám poděkovat za záchranu našich životů.
m.e: We came to thank you for saving our lives.

m.e: I guess I should thank you for saving my life.

m.t: Můj táta říká, že vám mám poděkovat za záchranu života.
m.e: My father says I'm to thank you for saving my life.

m.e: You can thank me for saving your lives some other day.

m.e: But I assure you, if pushed, I would kill one to save 19.

m.e: Ok, I'm dialing up a rescue, but it's gonna take a few minutes.

m.e: I wanted to thank you for saving my little girl.

m.e: Among them being that you would sell us out to save your family.

m.t: A každá minuta, kterou tady ztrácíme, se dala využít na její záchranu.
m.e: And every moment we waste is a moment we could be working to retrieve her.

m.t: Fries to všechno musí dělat pro záchranu své ženy.
m.e: Fries must be doing all this to save his wife.

m.t: Jsem Tomovi moc vděčný za záchranu svého života.
m.e: I am very grateful to Tom for saving my life.

m.e: We got 5 minutes for search and rescue before this whole place comes down.

m.e: Getting to know each other a little bit better, it's not gonna stop us from saving the world.

m.t: To všechno za záchranu mého života.

m.e: Could there be like a power problem?
